notes.title: Versions supporting Chinese and Korean have been released.
notes.notes: From Ver1.03, Chinese and Korean languages are supported.

notes.title: [Ver.1.03] Update Information
notes.notes:
[Ver.1.03] Update Information

Chinese and Korean languages are now supported.
Experience coins can now be obtained even if the game ends before completion.
A UI hide button has been added to the bottom left corner of the screen when the game is completed or ends.
Background operation is now supported.

notes.title: [Ver. 1.02] Update information
notes.notes:
[Ver. 1.02] Update information

Fixed an issue that caused the UI to collapse at certain resolutions. Probably.
Fixed volume of some sound effects.

notes.title: 【Ver.1.01】Update Notes
notes.notes:
【Ver.1.01】Update Notes

Partially updated the character selection screen UI.
Revised the description for Nyascension 1.
Added a brief tutorial text to the main gameplay screen.
Fixed an issue where some sound effects were playing in mono.

notes.notes:

There is no problem with monetising the distribution.
